name: Industrial Tv Stand
description: Long, low rectangular TV console with a dark wood cabinet, broad drawer front, horizontal metal handle and recessed base. Includes one complete straight storage console; the television is separate.

name: Industrial Bath
description: Rectangular inset bathtub with a white outer surround, broad flat rim and rounded rectangular bathing basin. Includes the tub shell, integrated rim, drain and overflow opening as one bathroom fixture; taps and shower fittings are separate.

name: Industrial Bed 1
description: Rectangular bed assembly with a black tubular metal frame, open rail headboard and footboard, mattress, cream bedding, stacked pillows and a dark textured throw across the foot. All bed parts and textiles share one footprint; bedside tables are separate.

name: Industrial Bed 2
description: Rectangular bed assembly with a black tubular metal frame, open rail headboard and footboard, mattress, burgundy duvet and pillows, a small cream accent cushion and a taupe throw. Includes the furnished bed as one asset; bedside tables are separate.

name: Industrial Bed Master
description: Rectangular double-bed assembly with a low dark wood platform, broad padded headboard, mattress, navy bedding, dark pillows, a brown accent cushion and a draped beige throw. Includes the frame and all bedding in one footprint; bedside storage is separate.

name: Industrial Closet Storage
description: Tall rectangular open wardrobe with a dark wood frame, narrow shelves down both sides, an open central hanging bay, upper hanging rail and divided lower storage. Includes the shelving, folded linens and stored contents as one straight wardrobe assembly.

name: Industrial Fridge
description: Tall rectangular refrigerator with dark wood-effect door panels, separate upper refrigerator and lower freezer compartments, and vertical handles. Includes one complete freestanding fridge-freezer cabinet in a single compact footprint.

name: Industrial Kitchen Chair 1
description: Single dining chair with a compact rounded-square footprint, a slender curved metal frame, wraparound arm rails, padded brown seat and backrest, and four narrow legs. Includes one complete chair; the dining table and other chairs are separate.

name: Industrial Kitchen Chair 2
description: Single dining chair with a compact rounded-square footprint, a curved brown upholstered backrest, padded seat, open gap beneath the back and four tapered legs with curved side supports. Includes one complete chair; the dining table is separate.

name: Industrial Kitchen Counter
description: Straight fitted kitchen assembly along one wall, combining dark base cupboards and drawers, overhead cabinets, tall storage at both ends, a continuous worktop and backsplash, an integrated cooktop, extractor hood, under-cabinet lighting and a glass-front undercounter appliance. Place the entire cabinet-and-appliance assembly as one rectangular footprint; the sink unit and standalone refrigerator are separate.

name: Industrial Kitchen Sink
description: Straight rectangular kitchen sink assembly combining dark cabinet segments, a stone-effect worktop, two adjacent inset metal sink basins, a shared faucet and projecting storage sections. Both basins, the faucet, counter and cabinets are included in one footprint; cooking appliances and the refrigerator are separate.

name: Industrial Kitchen Table 1
description: Long rectangular dining table with a thick gray stone-effect tabletop and two broad slab supports underneath. Includes the tabletop and both supports as one straight table; chairs, benches and place settings are separate.

name: Industrial Kitchen Table 2
description: Long rectangular dining table with a wood plank tabletop, dark metal edging, two rectangular metal end frames and a low connecting stretcher. Includes the complete table and support frame in one footprint; dining chairs and benches are separate.

name: Industrial Lightstand
description: Compact box-shaped dark wood bedside cabinet with a square top, a broad drawer and an open lower shelf, topped by a small spherical lamp with an angled opening. Includes both the nightstand and lamp as one asset in the same footprint.

name: Industrial Living Chair
description: Single orange upholstered lounge armchair with a rounded footprint, deep padded seat, curved wraparound back and arms, and short angled wood legs. Includes the complete armchair as one seat; side tables and other seating are separate.

name: Industrial Living Table
description: Low rectangular coffee table with a recessed wood plank top framed by dark metal and two broad metal end supports. Includes the tabletop and support structure as one straight table; sofas and chairs are separate.

name: Industrial Sofa
description: Straight two-seat sofa with a rectangular footprint, dark gray upholstery, two broad seat cushions, padded back cushions and arms, loose accent pillows and a beige throw draped over one side. Includes the sofa and textiles as one asset; there is no chaise or corner extension.

name: Industrial Stool
description: Round backless stool with a circular dark wood seat, four splayed wood legs and connecting cross braces. Includes one complete stool in a compact circular footprint; tables and additional stools are separate.

name: Industrial Toilet
description: Compact white floor-standing toilet with an elongated oval bowl and closed seat, a rounded pedestal base and a rectangular rear cistern with a top flush button. Includes the bowl, seat, base and cistern as one complete bathroom fixture.

name: Industrial Toilet Sink
description: Long rectangular bathroom vanity combining a gray stone-effect surround and countertop, two inset rectangular white basins, two individual faucets and one continuous open lower shelf. Both sinks, both taps and the vanity body are included in a single straight footprint; mirrors are separate.

name: Industrial Washing Dryer
description: Side-by-side laundry assembly with two rectangular dark appliance cabinets, one front-loading washing machine and one front-loading tumble dryer, each with a large circular front door. Includes both machines together in one wide rectangular footprint; place the pair once rather than treating it as a single machine.
